sections.name: Improved
items: Threads you've already opened now pick up changes made elsewhere (a comment from the browser or the CLI, a label, a close) without a manual refresh: Triage checks them against GitHub when you open one, on every poll and when the window comes forward

sections.name: Fixed
items: Clicking a row that was still selected after closing its thread did nothing

sections.name: New
items: First release: your GitHub notifications inbox in the menu bar, with the whole conversation, replies and triage actions without opening a browser
Done, Save, Snooze, Unsubscribe and Mark as read or unread, with undo, keyboard shortcuts and bulk actions
Done tab for finding threads you cleared too early, with Move to Inbox
Filters by repo, org, reason, state, label and author, plus saved filters
Conversations are fetched ahead of time, so threads open instantly
macOS notifications for new activity, a global hotkey and launch at login

versions.html:
New

  • First release: your GitHub notifications inbox in the menu bar, with the whole conversation, replies and triage actions without opening a browser
  • Done, Save, Snooze, Unsubscribe and Mark as read or unread, with undo, keyboard shortcuts and bulk actions
  • Done tab for finding threads you cleared too early, with Move to Inbox
  • Filters by repo, org, reason, state, label and author, plus saved filters
  • Conversations are fetched ahead of time, so threads open instantly
  • macOS notifications for new activity, a global hotkey and launch at login
